$doc: SHARD-PLATFORM SF50-g: Signal Dunes' four midpoint entries (G93 / G99 / G103 / G131) walked edge <-> shard on the live standalone world (the trusted runtime: terrain, rocks, dressing and colliders). The bake holds each midpoint at exactly y = 0 across 17.6 m for 47 m in. Signal Dunes' authored play bounds (+-200 m) are lifted for the walk, as the grid lifts them. Run: scripts/browser-lane.sh node progress/shard-platform/sf50/entries.mjs --slug=sunscar-dunes --route=progress/shard-platform/sf50/entries-route.json --url=<served build> --out=<dir>
